}}'''Bergevin''' is one of the quartermasters of the [[Band of the Red Hand]].{{ref/book|13|Epilogue}}

== Activities ==
[[Olver]] has one of Bergevin's fishing knives, and intends to use it against the [[Trolloc]]s when they attack [[Caemlyn]].{{Ref/book|13|Epilogue}}

==Trivia==
*Bergevin is named after Glenn Bergevin, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
